name: navigate_to_page
description: Navigate Jarvis to a different page. Use for home, news, calendar, home-assistant, 3d-printers, and music pages. NEVER use this for map or location requests — use map_command instead.

parameters.description: The page to navigate to. Use 'home' for the main screen, 'news' for the live news feed, 'calendar' for schedule/planning, 'home-assistant' for smart home, '3d-printers' for the Bambu Lab dashboard, 'music' for the full-screen music player.
